method: Production CSS cascade + server-rendered markup + absolute border-box/paint-bound calculation. No browser execution.
geometryChange: Only landscape: Spin and Turbo move down 4px, replacing the 4px Auto–Spin gap with the existing 8px spacing token. All sizes, other positions, reel geometry and 160px portrait allocation unchanged.
limitations: No browser getComputedStyle, live pointer interaction, device rasterization or screenshot comparison was performed.
Restriction tooltips are intentional overlays and are excluded from module separation; speed/lock badges are included.
Feature states are supplied to the real control component; no gameplay or settlement is executed.
